note: Rustic campground strung along Macedonia Brook Road in the woods of Kent. Only the 21 standard sites (25-35 ft, ten pull-through) take an RV; the pop-up/tent sites are mostly 20 ft. Firewood may not be available because of limited staffing, and cell service is extremely limited. No pets or alcohol. --Claude
